name: shell-quality
description: Teaches Claude the current ShellCheck and shfmt workflow for shell scripts (format, then check; rc files and EditorConfig; correct fixes for common SC codes; macOS Bash 3.2 portability; pre-commit and CI), and, only when you ask and choose a scope and a configuration, installs Claude Code hooks that format and check every shell script Claude edits, deny suppression directives and configuration changes, and keep Claude from finishing until the scripts are clean.
